drills.title: Bank the Secret Skill Shot
drills.text: Groove the full-power plunge-to-tombstone timing until it's automatic -- this is the single highest-value, lowest-risk opener in the ruleset.

drills.title: Three Center-Ramp Reps
drills.text: Since three clean center-ramp hits is all it takes to open the House, drill the shot in sets of three until it's a reflex rather than a hopeful flip.

drills.title: Thread the Crossover Blind
drills.text: Practice the gap shot between the two crossover drop targets without knocking either one down -- land it clean and House Attack qualifies instantly, no ramp count needed.

drills.title: Three-Hedge Sweep
drills.text: Run all three hedge scoops back to back and stay ready for the kickback on each one instead of watching the shot land.

drills.title: Sanitarium Chain, Start to Finish
drills.text: Once up on the deck, run the full standup-and-drop sequence without a miss -- there's no flipper up there to bail you out if you're off-line.

drills.title: Upper Flipper Control
drills.text: The House deck has its own flipper pair that only wakes up mid-battle -- the first few times House Attack triggers, spend the whole health fight just getting a feel for how those upper flippers aim before worrying about score.
drills.reps: until House Attack triggers naturally, then 10 shots per flipper

actionButton.how: Spooky did not put a button on the lockdown bar here. What Halloween does give you is a second flipper button on each side of the cabinet, wired to the pair of flippers up on the House playfield — they do nothing until the ball is up there for House Attack, then they are the only way to aim at the spinners. The plunge is automatic, so you pick your skill shot with the main flippers and the ball leaves on its own.

howItPlays.objective: Michael Myers has come home to Haddonfield, and you hunt him across a graveyard, three hedges, an asylum deck and the Strode house itself. Bank blood to buy scoring, drive each of the three story multiballs to its Super Jackpot, and survive The Night He Came Home.
loop: Knock down the three center drop targets to light the Jack-O-Lantern scoop, your hub for mode select, the blood store and any waiting extra ball.
Start an easy pumpkin mode off the scoop and win it to earn blood, then spend blood at that same scoop for doubled scoring you keep for the rest of the ball.
Lock balls at the three hedges, up on the asylum deck, and inside the Strode house to run the three story multiballs.
Cash the Super Jackpot in Hedge, Sanitarium and House multiball to qualify Boogeyman, the six-ball finale.
Start enough pumpkin modes to reach The Night He Came Home, where the knife jackpots and the tombstone super pay the most anywhere on the machine.

lights.name: Jack-O-Lantern Scoop
lights.lit: Clearing the three center drops lights the scoop, and while it is lit the mode select, the blood store and any earned extra ball are all waiting there; the drops reset after each trip so you can relight it over and over.

control.effect: cycle the scoop award list -- an unplayed pumpkin mode, a blood purchase, or a lit extra ball -- so you drop in on the one you want
control.when: the scoop is lit and holding you at its award menu

lights.then: Start an easy pumpkin mode and win it to earn blood, then return to spend ten blood on doubled scoring right before a multiball so the boost rides across every jackpot. Blood keeps building all game rather than resetting, and every mode you start here also climbs you toward the final wizard.

lights.name: The Three Hedges
lights.lit: Shooting the left ramp reveals Michael behind a hedge for a few seconds, which lights that hedge scoop to accept a lock; a locked ball stays locked, and trapping one at each of the three fires Hedge Multiball on its own.
lights.then: Lock all three for the friendliest multiball on the machine, reveal-and-bank the three hedge jackpots, then cash the Super at the middle hedge -- the first Super also adds a ball, and that Super is one of the three you need for Boogeyman.

lights.name: Judith Myers Tombstone
lights.lit: Five hits on the lower-right lane target, or the hidden skill shot straight off the plunge, trap a ball behind the tombstone drop; the trapped ball releases into a two-ball multiball whose flat double scoring stacks on top of anything else you have running.
lights.then: Start it underneath a story multiball so the flat 2x compounds everything, and shoot the tombstone during the multiball for a Super that raises later jackpot values. In the final wizard this same target pays ten million times the balls in play -- the single largest award in the game.

lights.name: Smith's Grove Sanitarium
lights.lit: The entry scoop lifts the ball onto the asylum deck, where a lit standup or drop is the next link in a four-step qualify chain; there is no flipper up there to save a miss, so an off-line shot just rattles until it settles.
lights.then: Run the left standup, the right standup and the drop-then-scoop to arm the multiball, which begins on your next drain. Its Super is the second of the three story supers that qualify Boogeyman.

lights.name: The Strode House
lights.lit: Five center-ramp shots qualify House Attack and divert the ball up to the house deck, where its own upper flippers wake up; rip the spinners to drain Myers' health while the upper drop chips Laurie's, and the middle standups heal her, all against a hard sixty-second clock.
lights.then: Beat Myers, then shoot the upper drop into the crossover to start House Multiball, where every orbit and ramp lights for jackpots feeding a climbing crossover Super. Threading that crossover clean between its two drops -- the Dirty Pool loop -- qualifies House Attack instantly and skips the five ramps.

lights.name: Combo Shots
lights.lit: The two orbits and the two ramps each count as combo shots; alternate them without repeating a lane and every link scores more than the last, and this same set is the win condition for the first easy pumpkin mode.
lights.then: Chain a full four-way pass for escalating points, doubled while Death in the Driver's Seat is running. Keeping the ball moving through these shots is also how you feed the hedges and grind center-ramp hits toward opening the house.

lights.name: Knife-Blade Standups
lights.lit: Lit knife blades stud the ramp and orbit mouths; clearing all six wins the Escape the Kitchen mode, and once the final wizard is running a blade you collect turns red so a second hit on it doubles that jackpot.
lights.then: Sweep the six blades to win the kitchen mode for its blood. In The Night He Came Home, double a red blade, relight the dark ones at the crossover, then cash the tombstone super at ten million times the balls in play -- the biggest single hit on the table.

scoring.text: Open with the hidden skill shot -- plunge and knock the lower-right target to trap a ball at the tombstone with almost no drain risk. Then chip the three center drops and start an easy pumpkin mode at the scoop, banking blood while you get a feel for the fast, save-less outlanes.

Bank ten blood and buy doubled scoring just before you dive into a multiball so the 2x carries across the jackpots. Lock the three hedges for the easiest multiball to reach, then start Tombstone Multiball underneath it so its flat 2x compounds on top.

Cash the Super Jackpot in Hedge, Sanitarium and House multiball, then relock all six balls across three lock phases for the six-ball Boogeyman finale. The Night He Came Home stands beside it as the final wizard, where the tombstone super pays ten million times the balls in play.
